$Comment: One hit of the Thumper beat: the vanilla soft footstep on sand (Walk_Sand_01, 16 KB) by path, half an octave down and louder. Units: Pitch is semitones (-12 to 12), Volume is decibels (-100 to 10), both on the event; ThumpPitchSemitones and ThumpVolumeDb in the Thumper config are written over them at server start. Heard in a ball with a falloff from SFX_Attn_Loud (full volume to 15 blocks, silent at 45); the Thumper system plays one world sound per hit at the Thumper, so everyone nearby hears it. MaxInstance leaves room for several Thumpers.
